product.title: Istoria lumii în date. De la Epoca pietrei până în anul 2000
product.description: Dacă vrei să afli când a fost inventată roata, când s-a născut Shakespeare sau când a ajuns primul om pe Lună, fii sigur că vei găsi răspunsul în cartea aceasta. Cu peste 3 500 de date și o bogăție de ilustrații revelatoare, Istoria lumii în date este un ghid indispensabil pentru toți cei care vor să știe cine, când și unde. Vei descoperi în ea prezentări succinte, dar riguroase, ale celor mai importante momente și realizări din istoria omenirii: războaie și revoluții, invenții și descoperiri epocale, mișcări artistice, ascensiunea și căderea marilor imperii – de la primele așezări umane, vechi de peste 10 000 de ani, până la începutul mileniului al III-lea. Pe piață sunt o mulțime de cărți de istorie excelente, [dar] aceasta este unică prin maniera de prezentare comparativă. Foarte recomandată pentru copiii de gimnaziu.“ The School Librarian

# The World Through Time: A Comprehensive Timeline of Human History

Are you looking to understand when Shakespeare lived, how and when the wheel was invented, or precisely when humanity first walked on the Moon? *The World Through Time: A Comprehensive Timeline* is an indispensable guide designed for anyone who wants definitive answers to "who," "when," and "where." This resource provides a monumental journey through human history in a clear, engaging, and data-rich format.

This detailed volume showcases over 3,500 key historical facts, complemented by rich and illustrative graphics. It is the perfect scholarly companion for students seeking a rigorous yet accessible understanding of civilization's sweep.

## Discovering the Span of Civilization

*The World Through Time* takes readers on an epic journey that spans from the earliest human settlements over 10,000 years ago up to the dawn of the third millennium. It is designed not just as a collection of dates, but as a comparative guide to major historical movements and accomplishments.

Whether you are a student needing support for your coursework or a curious mind simply wanting to connect the dots between antiquity and modernity, this book provides comprehensive coverage of:

*   **Major Empires:** The rise, peak, and inevitable decline of the world's greatest civilizations.
*   **Transformative Events:** Detailed accounts of pivotal wars, revolutions, and social movements that shaped human destiny.
*   **Innovation & Discovery:** Spotlights on epoch-making inventions, scientific breakthroughs, and artistic shifts throughout history.

The bookâs unique strength lies in its comparative presentation styleâoffering succinct yet academically rigorous summaries of humanity's greatest achievements and challenges. It is highly recommended for middle school students looking to solidify their understanding of global events.

**Q: Is this book suitable for advanced college students?**
A: While the scope is immense, the content is specifically structured to provide concise and clear information. It is primarily recommended for secondary school (middle/high school) level readers who are building a foundational, comprehensive knowledge of global history.

**Q: Does it cover modern history beyond the year 2000?**
